title: 黎曼：不连续的函数也能有面积吗

claims.statement: 黎曼1854提交研究三角级数表示的就职资格论文，含积分概念与适用范围
claims.locator: Riemann §4 and Dedekind 1867 preface; Göttingen manuscript catalogue

claims.statement: 1854原稿、1867独立印本、1868学会卷册文献口径不可混为同一年
claims.locator: Dedekind preface July 1867; ETH 1867 edition; SEP 1868 convention

claims.statement: 研究傅里叶级数表示时黎曼需明确何种函数可被定积分处理
有界函数的任意采样黎曼和在网格→0时统一到I的定义
claims.locator: modern tagged partition definition vs historical §4
tagged partition absolute error ≤2 mesh width

claims.statement: 有理数指示函数在任何区间有理/无理点均稠密，取样和可恒0或1
claims.locator: density of Q and R\Q; every partition allows both

claims.statement: Dirichlet rational indicator on [0,1] is not Riemann integrable
claims.locator: two sample choices difference 1 at arbitrary mesh

claims.statement: Thomae function with height inverse reduced denominator is Riemann integrable and integral 0
claims.locator: modern analysis theorem; deferred full epsilon proof

claims.statement: dense discontinuities do not alone determine Riemann integrability
Darboux upper and lower sums were later streamlined presentation, not Riemann 1854 original form
claims.locator: Cambridge history excerpt and original text

claims.statement: Lebesgue criterion: bounded f Riemann integrable iff discontinuities measure zero is modern later theorem
claims.locator: Lebl theorem with historical dating caveat

claims.statement: Fourier coefficients motivated integration limits and then epsilon quantifier rigor
claims.locator: historical problem and editorial chapter bridge

claims.statement: Correctness of integral is quantifier-independent of partition and tags, not mere ability to approximate one chosen sum

caveats: 黎曼1854提交，1867独立印本已核，部分学会卷册1868口径另列，不把首次出版死写1868。
任意采样和与ε–δ公式为现代统一表述；上/下和及测度判据均系后世发展。
阶梯、Dirichlet与Thomae三个例子是现代教学核算，不伪称黎曼原文逐字。
